derivation: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of G4049 (περισπάω);

occurrences.text: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
